title: If I ran the world
blurb: Second conditional — if + Past Simple + would

steps.title: Read each statement. Do you agree or disagree?
Слова урока
steps.sub: Нажми на карточку, чтобы увидеть перевод

words.def: an important problem that people discuss and try to solve
the slow rise in the temperature of the earth caused by human activity
the situation in which people do not have enough food to eat
a sudden natural event, such as a flood or an earthquake, that causes great damage
a long line of hard, colourful structures under the sea, built by tiny animals
one of the large land areas of the world, such as Africa or Asia
in or to a foreign country
a medicine or a treatment that makes an illness go away
a new thing that somebody has designed and made for the first time
a good effect or an advantage that something brings
having a lot of influence or control over people and events
safe, and not likely to be lost or taken away
much greater or more severe than usual
able to learn, understand and think quickly
to move outwards over a wider area, or to reach more people

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html: I would take a smart pill if I knew it was safe.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html: If only a few people could afford them, that would give them an unfair advantage.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html: True, but if you danced a little bit every day, then you would become confident.

steps.prompt: The verb after if is in the past form. Is the speaker talking about the past?
options: Yes — all four sentences are about last year
Yes — the past form always means past time
No — the past form here means “this is not true”
No — the past form here means “this will definitely happen”
steps.answer: No — the past form here means “this is not true”

steps.title: Choose the form that fits.
steps.prompt: If I ____ more money, I would travel.

steps.title: Choose the form that fits.
steps.prompt: If she asked me, I ____ yes.

steps.title: Choose the form that fits.
steps.prompt: What would you do if you ____ a million?

steps.title: Choose the form that fits.
steps.prompt: If I ____ you, I’d say nothing.

steps.title: Now say it out loud in sixty seconds.
Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ talk about something that is not true and say what would follow — If I had more time, I would…
✓ put the two halves in either order, with or without the comma
✓ ask an imaginary question — What would you do if…? — and answer it shortly
✓ use If I were you… , and soften a result with could or might
✓ talk about world problems — hunger, global warming, natural disasters, financial security
✓ say what is or was done when the doer does not matter recycled — The reef is damaged by warmer water
